questions.text: **Periodic Cancellation Graphs:** Determine the total combined length of all intervals within the domain $x \in [0, 100\pi]$ for which the equation $\arcsin(\sin x) = \arccos(\cos x)$ holds true.

For acute \(\theta\), suppose
   \[
   \sin\theta+\cos\theta=\frac{5}{4}.
   \]
   Find the exact value of
   \[
   \tan\theta+\cot\theta.
   \]

Write
   \[
   5\sin x-12\cos x+13\sin\!\left(x+\frac{\pi}{2}\right)
   \]
   as a single trigonometric function of the form \(R\sin(x+\phi)\), and hence determine its maximum value.
